summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco S&P MidCap 400 Revenue ETF (RWK) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P MidCap 400 Revenue-Weighted index. The fund tracks a revenue-weighted index of US stocks from the committee-selected S&P MidCap 400. RWK was launched on Feb 22, 2008 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: RWK is an equity ETF with a total of 403 individual holdings. The top holdings are Albertsons Companies stock at 3.36%, TD SYNNEX at 2.85%, Performance Food Group Company at 2.68%, American Airlines Group at 2.51%, and Molina Healthcare at 1.79%.
